name: Mohit Aggarwal
player_statement:
A complete player, Mohit Aggarwal has made a big mark in cricket. With 4 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 39, with an average of 18.33 and a quick strike rate of 157.14. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 12.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 7.83. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
